patch_description: The metric target ratio is (dmin/dmax)^2 ≈ 1/4.1658 ≈ 0.24003, achieved by the known optimal configuration for 14 points: an icosahedron's 12 vertices plus two antipodal points along an axis (poles), appropriately scaled. Random Gaussian seeds rarely converge to this. I add explicit structured seeds (icosahedron + poles variants with varying pole radius and rotations), keep a couple of random seeds, optimize each with L-BFGS-B on the smooth min/max objective, and exit early once the target ratio ~0.2395 is reached (score ≥ that means combined_score ≥ 0.997). This both boosts score and controls runtime.
